description: Collection completion for one set, optionally one rarity ("Which uncommons from Ravnica Remastered am I missing?" → set "ravnica remastered", rarity "uncommon"). Accepts a set code or name. Every printing in the set is classified once: owned (≥1 real copy of this exact printing) | owned_other_printing (real copy from a different set only) | proxy_only (the user's only copies are proxies) | missing (no copy at all). `counts` always covers all four; `status` picks which card lists are returned — the default "missing" also includes the proxy_only and owned_other_printing lists for disclosure. Missing cards are priced cheapest-first in `currency` (default USD; cached prices at most 7 days old); price_to_complete covers every card not owned as a real copy of this set's printing. finish "foil" answers "which foils am I missing": only printings that exist in foil/etched are in scope, only foil/etched copies count as owned, prices switch to foil prices, and missing entries carry owned_nonfoil when the user holds the card in nonfoil ("nonfoil" is symmetric via owned_foil — mention these wrong-finish copies when reporting). Foil-only printings are always priced from their foil price; with the default finish "any", owned entries report foil_quantity when some copies are foil/etched. DISCLOSURE: when proxy_only is non-empty, tell the user those cards are proxies — physically present but not tournament-legal and not tradeable — and never count them as collected.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

finish.description: Finish goal (default "any"). "foil" = foil-set tracking: foil/etched-capable printings only, foil/etched copies count, foil prices

set.description: Set code ("rvr") or set name ("Ravnica Remastered")

status.description: Which card lists to return (default "missing", which includes the disclosure lists)
